audits.text:
## fcd0466edb79

**Issue found: the advertised exact override contract is materially false.** On
source SHA-256
`e70a611ddedccfe8957f9cc571220623498c9e36adbbdb18304745e08d6ababb`, the
shared override gate ran 171,990 draws across 1,911 cases and reported 9,078
findings plus 3 warnings. A minimized concrete counterexample is easy/seed 0
with `texture='all_cols_marked', grid_w=10`: the generator returns width 8, not
10. Likewise `grid_h=10` returns height 6. `body_density` is inert across all
90 same-seed extreme sweeps, default draws omit provenance for `n_marks`,
`palette_size`, and `n_distinct_colors`, and an unknown override key is silently
accepted.

Evidence: `checks/audit-fcd-override/checks/fcd0466edb79_before_override_results.json`
and `checks/audit-fcd-override/checks/fcd0466edb79_before_override.log`. No fix
was made because this is an audit target.

triage.reason: fcd0466edb79 and1dd0439f7260: both current-source exact-override contract repair leads, already unapproved; width/height ignored, controls inert/rejected and unknown keys accepted. No audit-only patches or Racket authority changes accepted. Evidence is reviewer-reported, not independently rerun; accepted here means the finding/repair lead is considered, not that an audit repair is completed.
